title: EXAMPLES-001: The service discovery target is misspelled as `servce_discovery`, so `make all` builds a binary with the wrong name while `make clean` tries to remove `service_discovery`
summary: EXAMPLES-001: The service discovery target is misspelled as `servce_discovery`, so `make all` builds a binary with the wrong name while `make clean` tries to remove `service_discovery`. The clean rule also omits `remote_server_client_mount` and uses plain `rm`, so it fails when outputs are absent. Rename the target to `service_discovery`, update `all`, and use `rm -f` for every generated example binary. Fixed: Correct target spelling, build every checked-in client, and remove all generated binaries idempotently.
